summary: Bhagwanlal Indraji was an Indologist and historian-archaeologist who received an honorary doctorate from Leiden University in ~1884. He was an honorary member of the Royal Asiatic Society (1877), a Fellow at the University of Mumbai (1882), and a member of the Asiatic Society of Mumbai.

Bhajagovinda Ghosh was a scholar of Tibetology and Buddhist studies. Attested in 1994, he served as Assistant Director at the Namgyal Institute of Tibetology and as an editorial board member for the Bulletin of Tibetology.

Bharat Bhushan Vidyalankar is a scholar in Indology and linguistics. He studied at Gurukula Kangri Vishwavidyalaya, the University of Delhi, and Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar University. He held positions at Kendriya Hindi Sansthan, Kendriya Hindi Shikshan Mandal, and Sandhaan (1991).

Bhikkhu Anālayo is a Buddhist studies and Indology scholar. He earned his PhD at the University of Peradeniya (~1997–2000) and completed his habilitation at the University of Marburg (~2000–2006). He held posts at Hamburg, Sri Lanka International Buddhist Academy, and Barre Center.

Bhikkhu Bodhi is a Buddhist studies scholar who earned his B.A. from Brooklyn College (~1962–1966) and his Ph.D. from Claremont Graduate University (~1968–1972). He served as editor at the Buddhist Publication Society (1984–2002) and president of BAUS (2013).

Bhikkhu Dhammapāla is a Buddhist studies scholar who studied at the Postgraduate Institute of Pali and Buddhist Studies and earned a PhD from the University of Hong Kong under the doctoral supervision of K. L. Dhammajoti.
Bhikkhu Nyanabodhi is a scholar in Buddhist studies who studied under and succeeded the traditional teacher Ayya Khema.

Bhikkhu Pāsādika works in Buddhist studies, Indology, and Tibetology, holding degrees from Magadh and Punjabi universities. He held academic posts at Punjabi, Marburg, and Würzburg universities, the Göttingen Academy of Sciences and Humanities, and was rector at the Frankfurt Buddhist Academy (2022).

Bhikkhuni Dhammanandā is a scholar in Buddhist studies who earned her Doctor of Philosophy from the Postgraduate Institute of Pali and Buddhist Studies, supervised by Tilak Kariyawasam and Daya Edirisinghe.
Bhikkhunī Dhammadinnā works in Buddhist studies. She served as an Assistant Researcher at Dharma Drum Buddhist College (attested 2012) and held a post at Dharma Drum Institute of Liberal Arts.

Bhimrao Ramji Ambedkar worked in Buddhist studies, philosophy, and religious studies. He studied at Columbia University, the University of London, and LSE. He served as professor at Sydenham College (1918, 1920) and principal of Government Law College, Mumbai (1935).
Bhogilal Sandesara was an Indologist who studied under Rasiklal Chhotalal Parikh. He served as Head of the Gujarati Department at Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda, attested in 1957.
Bhāgīratha Prasāda Tripāṭhī was an Indologist and linguist who held positions at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University, attested in 1976 and attested in 1989 as head of the Research Department.

Bidia Dandaron was a scholar of Buddhist studies and Tibetology who studied at Saint Petersburg State University (~1934–1937) under Andrei Ivanovich Vostrikov. In 1957, he became a research fellow at the Institute of Mongolian, Buddhist and Tibetan Studies.

Bihani Sarkar is a scholar of Indology and religious studies who held a post at the University of Hamburg and is attested in 2026 as Senior Lecturer in Comparative Non-Western Thought at Lancaster University.

Bimal Krishna Matilal was a scholar of Indology and philosophy. He studied at the University of Calcutta and Harvard University under Daniel H. H. Ingalls. He taught at the University of Toronto (~1968–1977) and Oxford University (1977–1991).

Bindeshwari Prasad Sinha was an Indologist and historian-archaeologist. He earned his Ph.D. at the University of London (SOAS) under Lionel David Barnett. His posts included Patna College (~1942), Patna University department head (1958), and K. P. Jayaswal Research Institute.

Bing Chen is a scholar of Buddhist studies, religious studies, and Sinology. He has held positions as Professor at Sichuan University (from ~1987) and at the Chengdu Academy of Social Sciences (attested 1993).

Bingtao Ma is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Sinology who completed an MA at Peking University (-2008) and a PhD at The Chinese University of Hong Kong under the supervision of Xue Yu (attested 2015).

Birgit Kellner is a scholar of Buddhist studies, Indology, and Tibetology. She earned her doctoral degree at Hiroshima University under Shoryu Katsura. Her career includes posts at Heidelberg University, the University of Vienna, and the Institute for the Cultural and Intellectual History of Asia.
